presentation.summary: Authenticate Silo users through LDAP, Synology LDAP Server, or Active Directory.
presentation.description_markdown: Adds password-based LDAP authentication to Silo. Supports LDAPS, StartTLS, stable external identities, direct group allowlisting, Active Directory group-to-role synchronization, and automatic Silo account provisioning.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin, open its configuration, and enter your LDAP connection and user-search settings. For Active Directory role synchronization, use the user group as the sign-in allowlist, configure the administrator group in Role synchronization, and explicitly enable Allow managed Silo roles on the Silo authentication binding. Keep an existing local Silo administrator account for recovery.

capabilities.description: Sign in with an LDAP directory account.

global_config_schema.title: LDAP authentication
global_config_schema.description: Connection, search, TLS, group-access, and role-synchronization settings.

fields.label: LDAP URL
fields.description: Use ldaps:// for implicit TLS or ldap:// with StartTLS.

fields.label: Use StartTLS
fields.description: Upgrade an ldap:// connection to TLS before binding.

fields.label: Allow plaintext LDAP
fields.description: Dangerous: permit ldap:// without StartTLS. Credentials will cross the network unencrypted.

fields.label: Search account bind DN
fields.description: Optional read-only account used to find the user entry.

fields.label: User search filter
fields.description: {username} is safely escaped and replaced at login.

fields.label: Stable subject attribute
fields.description: Use entryUUID for OpenLDAP/Synology LDAP or objectGUID for Active Directory.

fields.label: Group membership attribute
fields.description: Usually memberOf. Direct membership is evaluated.

fields.label: Sign-in group DNs
fields.description: Optional sign-in allowlist. Enter one group DN per line, such as CN=SiloUsers,OU=Groups,DC=example,DC=com. Administrator accounts must also satisfy this allowlist.

fields.label: Synchronize Silo roles from LDAP
fields.description: When enabled, administrator-group members are Silo admins and all other allowed LDAP users are Silo users. Role changes are applied at login and require Allow managed Silo roles on the host auth binding.

fields.label: Administrator group DNs
fields.description: Enter one administrator group DN per line, such as CN=SiloAdmins,OU=Groups,DC=example,DC=com.

fields.label: TLS server name override
fields.description: Leave blank to use the hostname from the LDAP URL.

fields.label: Custom CA certificate
fields.description: Optional PEM certificate for a private LDAP certificate authority.

fields.label: Skip TLS certificate verification
fields.description: Dangerous troubleshooting option. Do not enable in production.

fields.label: Overall LDAP operation timeout
fields.description: One absolute deadline shared by connect, TLS, bind, and search operations.
